chess_rating_fide.label: FIDE chess rating (standard)
chess_rating_fide.definition: A player's FIDE Standard (classical time control) Elo rating as published on the monthly FIDE rating list, among all players holding a published rating.
phrasings: what chess rating is the top 1%
what elo is top 1 percent of chess players
how good is a 2000 chess rating
what chess rating puts you in the top 1 percent
average chess rating of rated players

iq_score.label: IQ score
iq_score.base_noun: people who take a standardised IQ test
iq_score.definition: Full-scale score on a supervised, individually administered intelligence test such as the Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale or Stanford-Binet 5, scaled to a mean of 100 and a standard deviation of 15 against the test's same-age standardization sample.
phrasings: what IQ score is the top 1%
what IQ do you need to be in the top 1 percent
how rare is an IQ of 140
what IQ do you need for Mensa

bench_press_1rm.label: Bench press one-rep max
bench_press_1rm.definition: Heaviest weight a person can bench press for a single repetition, in kilograms; competition sources use the best successful raw (unequipped) lift at a sanctioned powerlifting meet, app sources use an estimated one-rep max from logged sets.
phrasings: how much can the top 1% of men bench press
how much should i be able to bench press

pushups_max.label: Push-ups in one test
pushups_max.definition: Number of correctly performed push-ups completed in a single test; the US Army APFT allows two minutes, Cooper Institute norms use one minute or no time limit.
phrasings: how many push ups can the top 1% of men do
how many pushups should i be able to do
average number of push ups for men
how many push ups is elite

instagram_followers.label: Instagram follower count
instagram_followers.definition: The number of accounts following a given public Instagram account, as displayed on its profile, across accounts observed on the platform.
phrasings: how many Instagram followers puts you in the top 1% of accounts
how many Instagram followers is top 1 percent
what percentile is my Instagram follower count
how many Instagram followers does the average account have
how many followers do you need to be in the top 10% on Instagram
what percent of Instagram accounts have over 1 million followers
how many followers makes you a top Instagram account

reading_speed_wpm.label: Silent reading speed
reading_speed_wpm.definition: Words per minute read silently, with comprehension, when reading ordinary continuous text at one's normal pace.
phrasings: how fast do people read wpm
what reading speed is top 1 percent
is 400 wpm a fast reading speed
how many words per minute does the average person read
reading wpm compared to other people

sleep_hours_nightly.label: Nightly sleep duration
sleep_hours_nightly.definition: Hours of sleep obtained in a typical night, measured by a wrist accelerometer over at least three nights (self-reported figures run longer).
phrasings: how many hours of sleep does the median adult get
average hours of sleep per night for adults
how much sleep do most adults get
how many hours do people sleep
what percent of adults sleep less than 7 hours
is 6 hours of sleep below average
how much sleep does the average person get a night

typing_speed_wpm.label: Typing speed
typing_speed_wpm.definition: Words per minute on a transcription typing test, where one word is five characters including spaces, measured over a timed test or fixed set of sentences on a physical keyboard.
phrasings: what is a good typing speed
how many words per minute is fast
